program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    colors = sorted({v for _, _, v in marks})
    n = len(colors)
    # Diagonal bands are constant on either r+c or r-c; use the invariant
    # with fewer distinct values among the marked cells.
    plus = {r + c for r, c, _ in marks}
    minus = {r - c for r, c, _ in marks}
    if len(plus) <= len(minus):
        invariant = lambda r, c: r + c
    else:
        invariant = lambda r, c: r - c
    mapping = {}
    for r, c, color in marks:
        mapping[invariant(r, c) % n] = color
    return [[mapping[(invariant(r, c)) % n] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
